selection: Exclude normalized English/Turkish passage overlap and English/Turkish question overlap with any previously published corpus. Group rows by original passage ID or exact NFC/whitespace-normalized passage. Select first120eligible groups with >=2 questions sorted SHA256(namespace+groupID), alternate groups into dev/test, use first2 distinct normalized questions in SHA256(namespace+questionID) order per group. If fewer120 eligible groups, use largest even group count; no retrieval scores or model embeddings inform selection.
evidence_policy: Complete originating unmodified Turkish passage as evidence, not minimal answer spans. Query is human question only; choices and correct answer are retained only in provenance, never indexed or used to generate query. This adapts multiple-choice reading comprehension to passage retrieval.
split: All questions and identical/normalized-equivalent source passages stay in one split.120unique query texts per split target. Validation encrypted until final source/model/settings freeze.
limitations: Passage relevance is derived from source reading-comprehension pairing, not independent chunk support annotation
Whole-passage recall rewards recovering all source bytes, even bytes not necessary to answer the question
Passages are short and may be in pretrained models' training data
Human-translated Turkish is not original Turkish production data
